chain-geometry.scope: Conditional scalar prediction after successful isolated F1 activation, using the native left/up/right/down 0x40 chain rule and first matching mutation record. No timing, combat, camera, other dynamic mutations or Kirby physics simulated.
chain-geometry.collision_attribute_correction: 0x48 is passable water with attributes0x3, not a slope. 0xF3 has attributes0x41 and is passable chain terrain, not a solid wall.

clear_cell_probe.method: Four-neighbor point/cell adjacency only, starting at the native transition center tile; excludes slopes, one-way/raised platforms, hazards, currents, all unbroken terrain and dynamic objects. Paths do not prove Kirby movement or attack acceptance; missing paths do not prove impossibility.
clear_cell_probe.path_coordinates: Turn waypoints compress sequences of adjacent allowed tile cells; not controller inputs.

sequence-probes.scope: Supplemental scalar conditional point-connectivity witnesses; no ROM/assets, no emulator, no capability grant.

rooms.method: Three conditional clear-cell graph stages. Crumble clearance and successful lower bomb activation are stipulated, not simulated.
rooms.remaining_limits: Ordinary crumble contact/countdown, room-object interference, body clearance, low tunnel movement and the two actual attack contacts still require gameplay acceptance. Upper chain produces current tiles whose flow is outside this graph.

rooms.method: Explicit upward-only platform relaxation: admit tile0x0F only for upward adjacency steps into and out of it. All other steps require the strict clear-cell set. This is a cell model, not a Kirby physics simulation.
rooms.remaining_limits: The strict graph deliberately stops at one-way platforms. The positive relaxed path shows why that negative is not proof of a solid-wall separation; validate climbing/flight, collision-body clearance and target attack in gameplay.
